claims.statement: The reviewer re-derived the arms' central claims with fresh code rather than trusting them: 6/6 executable predicates pass, stable over 5 consecutive runs.
The reviewer's own checker discriminates: 3/3 inverting mutants flip their predicate.
W7 VERIFIED with a working control: a body-only mutation leaves the emitted .d.ts byte-identical while a signature mutation changes it.

Five findings confirmed across arms: repeat's precondition is unenforced AND silent; classify(NaN)==='positive'; MAX_RETRIES is rigidly typed and unreferenced; repeat is not atomic; body-only mutation is invisible to the type surface.
Round 0 is four honest qualitative probes, NOT a measurement: one toy file, one model family, no real repo source, cost telemetry unknown for three arms.

The reviewer's own first answer was wrong and was corrected in-document (a 4000 ms threshold produced a claim about the source that was about the machine; the reviewer's fix then reproduced the same error via a timing slope).
NOTHING here is canon. Twelve proposals were dispositioned; no arm result was promoted. Ratification routes to DECISION_PROCESS_TRACKER.md.
Benchmark R1 (cross-file silent-divergence recall) is specified but was NOT run; it requires owner go-ahead and agent budget.
